textRuns.value: Tips: Balance lines are disconnected presentation rows; all totals and period-end balances are supplied by model measures, not calculated by the visual. Bind Lines to BalanceLines[LineID], Period to Period[Period], and Actual/Budget/Prior to BS measures. Line metadata controls display formats and favorability. Context menu, tooltips and drillthrough are native Power BI behaviors and require eligible selected fields plus a configured destination.
